brief_title: Effectiveness of a Treat-to-target Clinic Led by a Nurse Consultants
official_title: A Randomised Study to Evaluate the Effectiveness of a Treat-to-target Clinic Led by a Nurse Consultant in Managing Patients With Type 2 Diabetes in Hong Kong

interventions.name: Structured care led by a nurse consultant

arm_groups.label: Structured Care
intervention_names: Other: Structured care led by a nurse consultant

primary_outcomes.measure: To assess the effectiveness of the nurse consultant led clinic in improving glycemic parameters in patients with type 2 diabetes

brief_summary: The investigators hypothesize a diabetes nurse consultant led team with particular emphasis on compliance and attainment of treatment targets in Type 2 diabetic patients will achieve metabolic control, improve clinical outcomes and levels of self efficacy compared to usual clinic-based care.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetic patients
* Aged between 18 and 75 years (inclusive)
* HbA1c \>8%
* Chinese in ethnicity
* patients under the care of clinicians who aimed the treatment targets of their patients as HbA1c \<7%, BP \<130/80 mmHg, and LDL-C \<2.6 mmol/L

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with clinically unstable psychiatric illnesses
* patients with terminal malignancy or other life-threatening diseases with less than 3-month expected survival
* patients who speak non-Cantonese dialect or a different language or have conditions that prevent effective face-to-face or telephone communications eg. Patients who are deaf or mute
* patients who live in nursing home with supervised treatment
* patients who are not available via telephone contact

sites.facility: Diabetes & Endocrine Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital
